title: kate-core: write a history entry as a journal line
summary: recovery.rs defines the JSON Lines recovery journal: a header line with the document path and one line per applied transaction with its edits and revisions. journal_line serializes a HistoryEntry and journal_line_from_str reads a line back. kate-core gains serde and serde_json for it.

lane.reason: A Cursor cloud agent codes this packet. workspace.rs is a 3,500-line file and the change touches its command dispatch. The Linux VM builds and tests kate-core. The owner Mac stays free for the window.

definitions.definition:
[dependencies]
# The recovery journal is JSON Lines. std has no JSON.
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

mod recovery;
pub use recovery::{JournalEdit, JournalHeader, JournalLine, header_line, journal_line, journal_line_from_str, journal_path, recovery_dir};

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add serde and serde_json to kate-core with the comment and run cargo update -p kate-core so Cargo.lock gains the edges only. Create recovery.rs with the SPDX header and add the module and the exports to lib.rs. format_version is 1. journal_line maps entry.forward.edits() to JournalEdit with start.0 and entry.revision_before.0 and revision_after.0, and serializes with serde_json::to_string, which has no newline. The test a_journal_line_round_trips builds a HistoryEntry with one insert of ab at Offset(2), revisions 3 and 4, asserts journal_line has no newline and journal_line_from_str gives one edit with start 2 and new ab, and that journal_path with a digest of 32 zero bytes ends with 64 zeros and .jsonl. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: recovery::tests::a_journal_line_round_trips
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because recovery.rs does not exist. After the change a history entry becomes one JSON line that reads back with its edits and revisions.
